title: Talk it through 1.1
role: Operations officer confirming travel arrangements with a colleague
can_do: I can give and ask for precise travel details in person and by phone.
I can use adverbs and quantifiers to be exact about times and numbers.

nodes.partner_line: Good morning. Could you give me the exact departure time of the group flight?
nodes.translation: Buenos días. ¿Podría darme la hora exacta de salida del vuelo del grupo?

options.text: The flight leaves at precisely ten twenty.
It departs at approximately half past ten.
It is scheduled to leave just after ten.

nodes.partner_line: And how many passengers are travelling in total?
nodes.model_reply: Exactly twenty-two passengers are coming with us.

nodes.partner_line: Is the transfer to the hotel included in the price?
nodes.translation: ¿El traslado al hotel está incluido en el precio?

options.text: Yes, the transfer is fully included.
No, it costs an extra twenty pounds per person.
It is included, apart from the porter service.

nodes.partner_line: Could you repeat the booking reference, please?
nodes.translation: ¿Podría repetir el código de reserva, por favor?

options.text: Certainly. I will send it to you by email.
Of course. I will spell it slowly for you.
Sorry, I do not have it with me, but I can call you back.

nodes.partner_line: Roughly how long is the layover in Madrid?
nodes.translation: ¿Aproximadamente cuánto dura la escala en Madrid?

options.text: It is about two and a half hours.
Just under three hours, I believe.

nodes.partner_line: Perfect. Please confirm everything in writing by tonight.
nodes.translation: Perfecto. Por favor, confírmelo todo por escrito antes de esta noche.

options.text: Certainly, you will have it by this evening.
I will email the full itinerary within the hour.
Of course. Is there anything else you need?
